description:
The 'inventory-system' project currently uses wildcard imports (e.g., 'import java.util.*;'), which violates the team's coding standards. 

Your task is to:
1. Configure IntelliJ IDEA's Java Code Style settings to disable wildcard imports. specifically, set 'Class count to use import with '*'' and 'Names count to use static import with '*'' to a high value (e.g., 999).
2. Apply 'Optimize Imports' to the entire project to replace all existing wildcard imports with explicit single-class imports.
3. Ensure the project still compiles successfully.
